You'll work closely with department leadership and cross\-functional partners while having meaningful ownership over how customers experience and adopt the platform.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
**Implementation Consultant**
Soutron Global · Customer Delivery · United States or Canada (Remote)

**About Soutron Global**
========================


Soutron Global builds and supports information management software for organizations whose value sits in their collections — corporate and law firm libraries, government agencies, national and corporate archives, museums, and public library consortia. The suite spans library services platforms, archival collection management, resource sharing, and discovery, deployed across North America, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific.  

Our customers do not buy software so much as they buy the continuity of a catalog that has been built, in some cases, over a century. That makes implementation the moment the relationship is decided.**Why this role exists**
========================


Customer Delivery is moving from a "do everything for the customer" model to defined roles with clear ownership. This seat is the delivery half of that change: a hands\-on implementation professional who takes a signed project from kickoff to signed customer acceptance, and who can be trusted with the two hardest categories of work in our book.  

**First, migrations.** Legacy installations in this sector are heavily customized, with bespoke data constructs and workflows built up over years. Moving them onto a current platform is a data problem before it is a software problem, and feature\-parity gaps have to be found in scoping rather than discovered at go\-live.  

**Second, upgrades.** Our library services platform is not multi\-tenant. An upgrade is not a platform event; it is a project per customer, run against a live production catalog that the customer cannot afford to have offline. A release wave across an installed base is therefore a coordinated delivery program, and it is the work most exposed to being done badly.  

You will carry a live project book from week one. You will not be building a function from scratch — the reporting, utilization view, and project governance already exist and are improving. You will be the person the hardest projects are given to.**What you'll own**
===================

* **End\-to\-end project delivery.** A concurrent book of implementation and services projects across the suite — our library services platform and our archival collection management products. Kickoff, discovery, scoping, configuration, data migration, integration setup, user acceptance testing, go\-live, and signed customer acceptance.
* **Data migration and reconciliation.** Extract, profile, transform, map, load, and reconcile customer catalog and archival data. Own the mapping specification, the validation plan, and the reconciliation evidence the customer signs against.
* **Legacy\-to\-current platform conversions.** Scope conversions off highly customized legacy installations, produce an honest feature\-parity gap assessment before the project is committed, and deliver the conversion with product and engineering.
* **Upgrade delivery for the installed base.** Own and improve the upgrade runbook, then execute the upgrade wave tied to each scheduled release. Sequence customers, agree windows, manage rollback, and land upgrades without production disruption or regression.
* **Configuration and enablement handoff.** Configure metadata models, cataloging templates, workflows, permissions, and reporting to the agreed specification — then hand off cleanly to the training and adoption team, who own post\-go\-live enablement.
* **Delivery pace as a revenue control.** Project revenue in this business is recognized on delivery, not on billing milestones. Slipped delivery is slipped revenue. You own the completion of what you committed, in the quarter you committed it, or you own the early and specific escalation that resets it.
* **Operating discipline.** Time logged weekly, project status current, risks raised in writing before they become escalations and estimates that hold up against your own actuals.
* **Customer onsite delivery.** Onsite discovery, data workshops, go\-live support, and recovery visits — in North America, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.

**Scope boundaries**
====================

**Area** **This role** **Owner and note**  


Project delivery and migration **Owns** End to end, through signed acceptance.  


Upgrade execution **Owns** Runbook and per\-customer execution for assigned accounts.  


Scoping and effort estimation **Owns** You produce the estimate and the parity gap assessment. Sales owns price.  


Training delivery and adoption **Owns** You own the configuration and training of train the trainer.
  

Support ticket queues **Does not own** Customer Support. Cross\-charging delivery people into the support queue is a known capacity leak and is being closed, not continued.  


Commercial terms, quotes, change\-order pricing **Does not own** Sales and Sales Operations. You raise the change, they price and paper it.  


Renewals, retention forecast, account strategy **Does not own** Customer Success and Renewals.  


Product roadmap and prioritization **Does not own** Product Owner. You supply the field evidence; they decide sequence.  


Custom code and platform engineering **Does not own** Engineering. You write the specification and test against it; scripting for migration and configuration is yours.  


People management **Does not own** No direct reports. This is a senior individual contributor seat.**Your first 90 days**
======================

**Window** **What we expect**  

**Days 1–30** Product and data fluency on the two platforms you will deliver on. Shadow two live projects. Read the open project book and give your manager an independent read on which commitments you believe are at risk and why. Take first ownership of two to three in\-flight projects.  

**Days 31–60** Carrying a full assigned book. First migration mapping specification authored and validated by you. A written assessment of the upgrade runbook, naming the specific steps that make upgrades slower or riskier than they need to be.  

**Days 61–90** At least \[two] projects taken to signed customer acceptance. Your assigned share of the release upgrade wave scheduled with dates and customer windows agreed. Time logging and status reporting clean for the full quarter, without reminders.  

**How success is measured**
===========================


Targets are set with your manager on joining and reviewed quarterly. Utilization is deliberately paired with completion: high utilization with low completion means projects are being over\-worked, and it is treated as a problem, not a result.**What we are looking for**
===========================

**Required**
------------

* Five or more years implementing enterprise or specialist software for external customers, personally owning delivery from kickoff to acceptance.
* Demonstrable hands\-on data migration work: profiling messy source data, authoring mapping specifications, transforming and loading, and reconciling the result well enough that a customer signs against it. SQL, plus at least one scripting language you use for real work (Python, PowerShell, Perl, or equivalent).
* Experience configuring a metadata\-driven or catalog\-driven application — data models, controlled vocabularies, templates, workflows, permissions, and reporting.
* A track record carrying eight or more concurrent customer projects without losing status accuracy.
* Experience with single\-tenant, on\-premise, or dedicated\-instance deployments, where an upgrade is a per\-customer project rather than a platform release. This is the single most important differentiator in this search.
* Credibility under go\-live pressure: you can hold a date when it should be held, and reset one early, specifically, and in writing when it should not.
* Time\-logging and forecast discipline as a habit, not an imposition.
* Clear written English. Mapping specifications, status notes, and risk escalations are the artifacts of this job.
* Authorized to work in the United States or Canada without sponsorship, and able to overlap with United Kingdom business hours for part of the working day.
* A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally, including to the United Kingdom and Ireland.

**Strongly preferred**
----------------------

* Delivery experience in the GLAM sector — galleries, libraries, archives, and museums — or in special libraries, legal information services, or records management.
* Working knowledge of cataloging and archival description standards: MARC 21, Dublin Core, EAD, ISAD(G), RDA, OAI\-PMH, or Z39\.50\.
* Prior work on an integrated library system, library services platform, archival collection management system, digital asset management system, or resource\-sharing platform.
* Public\-sector or government contract delivery, including work under formal acceptance and security requirements.
* Jira and Confluence as day\-to\-day delivery tooling.

**What we are not asking for**
------------------------------


You do not need to be a librarian or an archivist by training, and you do not need to have sold anything. Domain vocabulary can be learned in weeks by someone with genuine migration and delivery competence. The reverse is not true.**Compensation**
================


Base salary range for this role, published by country. The range reflects the level, not the location within a country; there is no location differential applied within either country.

jobs.description:
Overview:

We have an exciting ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** opportunity for an experienced professional to join our team at Pediatrix Medical Group. We are a national organization, and one of the nation’s largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.  

Talented business professionals from diverse backgrounds choose Pediatrix because we are an exciting and innovative company that focuses on a team approach to improve the lives of patients everywhere. We offer a diverse range of opportunities, competitive salaries and benefits, and a commitment to clinical excellence, we are confident that ***you'll love being a part of the Pediatrix team.***
Responsibilities:

The ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** will facilitate and support development, testing, and education for the clinical information systems. This position will serve as a technical resource for these projects. Consult clinical personnel as needed regarding clinical issues related to Clinical Information Systems. Responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining test scripts that ensure exhaustive testing of clinical information systems to ensure compliance with system specifications.  

* Tests and evaluates all new versions of the Clinical Information Systems before implementation at beta sites. Follow testing plan as designed.
* Interpret user problems and suggest appropriate system change proposals to correct issues and to enhance system functionality and performance.
* Executes functional, application, regression, and performance tests for new version releases.
* Makes on\-site visits to enhance beta testing on updated versions of the Clinical Information System. Annual review and update of the testing plan.
* Performs and facilitates research and testing, provide overall project leadership to ensure hospital and Physician client interfaces conform to the client's HL7 standards.
* Expedites all incoming questions/problems generated by the physicians regarding clinical information systems and facilitates resolutions.
* Screens and prioritizes all requests and implements in an efficient and timely manner.  

Review and update all Q/A items in JIRA related to production open, current build and specific projects.
* Collaborates with all departments to resolve issues in a professional and timely manner.  

Provides prompt, courteous, professional, and accurate information in all communications in dealing with physicians and other departments.
* Demonstrates a commitment to department objectives through consistent patterns of work behavior and positive representation.
* Responds to the department needs by accepting additional assignments, which may or may not be related to the job’s primary responsibilities to ensure the continuity of department services.
* Responsible for following all facility, organization and department precautions and procedures in the performance of all job duties to ensure a safe work environment for self and others.
* Stays current with HIPAA guidelines and ensures that the Clinical Information Systems are compliant with these guidelines.
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including night shifts and on call rotations
* Ability to work independently and demonstrate initiative and problem\-solving skills within a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment
* Effective prioritization skills and the ability to execute tasks high paced, deadline\-driven environment with the ability to multitask.

***Education/Experience:**** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 3\-5 years as a Quality Assurance Analyst or Product Support Analyst in a healthcare setting preferred.
* Experience with test planning, design and metrics, as well as working knowledge of product development cycle, testing process, and formal testing methodologies.
* Experience with EMR / EHR interfaces and implementation.
* Experience with HL7 interfaces.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to the specific needs as required.
* Some understanding of the NICU or Office Based setting and its functions is preferred.
* Proficient working knowledge of change management (defect, enhancement, new feature) tracking and source/version control systems.

 ***Software:**** Experience in Microsoft Office, Email, and Windows. Working knowledge of quality assurance process and methodologies.

We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that fit your life and lifestyle, supporting your health and overall well\-being. Some benefits are provided at no cost, while others require a cost share between employees and the company. Employees may also select voluntary plans and pay for these benefits through convenient payroll deductions. Our benefit programs are just one of the many ways Pediatrix \& Obstetrix helps our employees take care of themselves and their families.
About Us:  

Pediatrix Medical Group is one of the nation’s leading providers of highly specialized health care for women, babies and children. Since 1979, Pediatrix has grown from a single neonatology practice to a national, multispecialty medical group. jobs.title: Head of Implementation
jobs.description:
At maxRTE, we believe every patient deserves access to care without financial barriers and that healthcare providers should be equipped to deliver that care without absorbing unnecessary financial loss.


 With 1 in 4 Americans struggling to pay medical bills, hospitals and health systems face increasing challenges identifying active insurance coverage. Too often, coverage is missed or hidden, leaving patients with overwhelming bills and providers with lost revenue. Our software uncovers hidden coverage—incorporating over 1,500 direct payer connections—to help hospitals and health systems recover revenue while ensuring patients get the care they need.


 We are growing quickly and looking for someone to lead our Implementation team, to take end\-to\-end ownership of client launches, driving technical configuration, workflow validation, and early value realization for major enterprise healthcare clients.

  

As the Head of Implementation, you will serve as the strategic and technical lead for onboardings across enterprise healthcare providers and large health systems. You will own the implementation lifecycle end\-to\-end—from initial kickoff through client instance configuration, technical file integration, workflow testing, and go\-live handoff to Client Success. This position will be a player/coach role, where you will own some implementations yourself, and also build and manage a team.


 The ideal candidate operates independently without relying on dedicated technical support or project managers. You are equally comfortable leading strategic calls with revenue cycle executives as you are setting up client instances, handling file transfers, configuring software rules, and validating technical data pipelines.  

  

What You’ll Do

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Take full ownership of the client onboarding lifecycle for new and expansion clients, ensuring well\-scoped, timely, and high\-quality implementations.
* **Technical Instance Setup \& Configuration:** Directly set up, configure, and maintain client instances within the maxRTE platform, applying custom rules, filters, and coverage mappings.
* **Integration \& Data Exchange:** Guide and validate file transmission and data exchange mechanisms, including SFTP setups, batch processing, real\-time integrations, and API connection workflows.
* **Workflow Testing \& Validation:** Lead comprehensive end\-to\-end testing, placement file runs, return report analyses, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure high data quality and eliminate post\-launch rework.
* **Client Advisory \& Executive Presence:** Lead client\-facing implementation discussions with RCM executives, health system operations leaders, and IT stakeholders to translate complex clinical/billing requirements into software configurations.
* **Process Optimization \& Scaling:** Continuously refine implementation frameworks, establish technical onboarding best practices, and collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Client Success.
* **Team Leadership \& Development:** As the company grows, you will have the opportunity to build, manage, and coach a team of implementation and support professionals to scale our onboarding capabilities.

 **Requirements*** **Experienced Lead:** 8\+ years of hands\-on experience leading complex, highly technical software onboardings and implementations in a client\-facing role. Experience managing implementation specialists.
* **Technically Fluent:** Strong technical aptitude with deep experience in data transmission methods and system integrations. You are comfortable navigating complex technical configurations and troubleshooting data pipelines.
* **Scrappy \& Adaptive:** You thrive in ambiguity and are skilled at navigating undefined processes, driving clarity, process, and alignment. You are comfortable taking full accountability for both technical execution and project management without needing a separate PM or technical support engineer assigned to the account.
* **Analytical \& Detail\-Oriented:** Exceptional skill in auditing client placement files, return data, and platform configurations to ensure clean go\-lives and early ROI realization.
* **Strong Communicator:** Ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment and seamless collaboration across diverse teams.
* **Results \& ROI Oriented:** You are relentlessly focused on outcomes, driving toward 30\-90 day implementation timelines and ensuring clients realize positive ROI within 30 days of contract execution.
* **Preferred Qualifications:** Background in Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and proven success managing large\-scale implementations within complex healthcare environments or EHR platforms (e.g., Epic, Cerner) are preferred but not required.

 **Benefits*** **Impact:** Your work directly helps patients access care and enables health systems to recover critical revenue.
* **Autonomy \& Influence:** High ownership over the onboarding architecture with the ability to shape how maxRTE scales.
* **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits:** Market\-competitive salary, performance bonus, medical/dental/vision coverage, 401(k) matching, and unlimited PTO.
* **Culture:** Bi\-annual in\-person offsites, remote work flexibility, and a collaborative environment with really awesome smart people that values continuous learning and execution.

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Training Specialist, Praxis Health
jobs.description:
Praxis Health is looking for a **Clinical Systems Training Specialist** who builds and delivers the education clinic staff and providers need to work effectively in Praxis Health's clinical systems, with an initial focus on the Oracle Health EHR implementation. The role covers both halves of that work: designing training content and materials and delivering it directly to end users.



The role works closely with the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations, RLCMs, and Regional Clinic Provider Leads to schedule training and address workflow readiness.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Flexible hybrid schedule based on events, meetings, and other business needs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design training curriculum and materials for clinical systems, including the Oracle Health EHR, tailored to different clinic roles (providers, front desk, clinical staff).
* Deliver live training sessions, both in person and virtual, for clinic staff and providers.
* Develop and maintain quick reference guides, job aids, and other supporting training materials.
* Support go\-live and cutover activities for the Oracle Health EHR implementation, including at\-the\-elbow support during go\-live periods.
* Identify training gaps by working with clinic staff, providers, and the Clinical Systems Specialists on recurring issues that point to a training need rather than a system issue.
* Develop and deliver training on new technology and system updates as they roll out, working with the Clinical Systems Specialists to translate technical changes into end\-user education.
* Design and adapt training for AI\-enabled clinic tools, including ambient documentation and AI scribes, as adoption changes clinical workflows and how staff document.
* Coordinate training scheduling with Directors of Operations and RLCMs to minimize disruption to clinic operations.
* Gather and incorporate feedback from training sessions to improve future sessions and materials.
* Champion innovative approaches to training and education, using new tools and methods to make learning clinical systems more effective for staff and providers.
* Partner with Clinical Revenue Cycle, Population Health, Consumer Experience, and other departments to provide continuing education to end users as appropriate.


**What You Bring**


* Comfortable both designing training content and delivering it live to a range of audiences, from providers to front desk staff.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to adapt teaching style to different roles and comfort levels with technology.
* Organized and able to manage a training schedule across multiple clinics and regions.
* Comfortable identifying training gaps by distinguishing recurring issues that point to a training need from those that point to a system issue.
* Champions innovative approaches to training and education, using new tools and methods to make learning clinical systems more effective for staff and providers.
* Comfortable gathering and incorporating feedback from training sessions to improve future sessions and materials.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* 3 to 5 years of experience in training or education, ideally in a clinical or healthcare setting.
* Experience training clinical or healthcare staff on an EHR or other clinical system.
* Demonstrated ability to design training curriculum and materials tailored to different roles, not only deliver existing content.
* Experience developing and maintaining supporting training materials such as quick reference guides and job aids.
* Ability to coordinate training scheduling with operational stakeholders across multiple sites or regions.
* Experience building or establishing a training program from the ground up that has proven durable through subsequent system or organizational changes.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Cerner or Oracle Health.
* Exposure to AI tools in a healthcare setting; experience training staff on AI scribes or ambient documentation a plus.


**About Our Company**



Praxis Health is a family of medical groups providing high\-quality healthcare throughout the state of Oregon. Our community\-based clinics are the DNA of our business, providing better medicine, advocacy for our patients, and a satisfying and collaborative culture for our providers and staff. The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. We are not "big box" health care, but rather a company of small groups and clinics, of nimble micro\-cultures that can quickly adapt to industry changes, as well as patient needs. We have been serving communities across the beautiful and adventurous state of Oregon for over 50 years! And we are pioneers and thought leaders in the industry. Our commitment to innovative and operational excellence has allowed us to create healthcare solutions that are both cost\-efficient and cutting edge. Come see how healthcare is done right!


**General Physical Requirements**



Manual dexterity for office machine operation including computer and calculator; stooping, bending to handle files and supplies, mobility to complete errands for deliveries, or sitting for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Stress can be triggered by multiple staff demands and deadlines.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Lead Enterprise Epic Implementations Across a National Health System


Prime Healthcare is an award\-winning health system headquartered in Ontario, California. Prime Healthcare operates 55 hospitals and has more than 360 outpatient locations in 15 states providing more than 3\.0million patient visits annually. It is one of the nation’s leading health systems with over 60,000 employees and physicians. Twenty\-one of the Prime Healthcare hospitals are members of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, a 501(c)(3\) not\-for\-profit public charity. Prime Healthcare is actively seeking new members to join our corporate team!


Are you an experienced Epic leader who has successfully driven full\-cycle implementations across complex hospital environments?


Prime Healthcare is seeking an experienced Epic Implementation Manager (Clinical) to lead enterprise\-wide deployments across our national health system. You will drive end\-to\-end clinical application implementations, partner closely with clinical and executive leadership, and ensure successful adoption across complex care environments. This is a high\-impact leadership role where your expertise shapes how care is delivered across dozens of hospitals.


What makes this role compelling:

* Lead enterprise\-wide clinical Epic implementations across 50\+ hospitals
* Influence provider workflows, patient care, and clinical outcomes

Own delivery across full lifecycle: design build* go\-live
* Lead and mentor large high\-performing analyst teams
* Partner directly with CMOs, Nursing Leadership, and Executives


Responsibilities:

Under the direction of the Epic Program Manager, the Epic Implementation Manager oversees Clinical applications, and is responsible for managing all aspects of future Epic implementations at Prime hospitals. The Implementation Manager will build relationships with hospital leadership to ensure corporate and local initiatives are incorporated into future implementations. After each go\-live, the Implementation Manager will oversee a comprehensive handoff to the Production Support team, ensuring a successful transition of support for the hospital. The Implementation Manager will supervise performance of all analysts on their team, which is comprised of the applications in their domain Clinical.


In this role, you will serve as the driving force behind enterprise Clinical Epic implementations, leading hospitals through each phase of the journey; from early planning and workflow design to go\-live and stabilization. As a leader, you’ll not only deliver successful implementations, but also mentor and develop your team while building strong, lasting partnerships across the organization.


On any given day, you’ll collaborate with clinical and executive leaders to align system design with real\-world care delivery, guide your team through build and testing milestones, and proactively navigate challenges to keep implementations on track. You’ll be at the center of the action during go\-live, ensuring teams are supported, workflows function as intended, and clinicians are set up for success.


What You’ll Do:

* Lead end\-to\-end Clinical Epic implementations
* Oversee design, build, testing, training, go\-live, and stabilization
* Partner with clinical stakeholders to align workflows and system design
* Ensure adoption of best\-practice clinical workflows
* Lead, coach, and manage clinical application analyst teams
* Drive milestone execution, risk mitigation, and delivery outcomes
* Oversee post\-go\-live transition to support teams
* Travel Requirement: This is a remote role that requires frequent travel (up to 50–75% annually) to hospital sites across the U.S., notably during key implementation phases.

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Senior Implementation Project Specialist**About your role:**


As a Senior Implementation Project Specialist, you will lead implementation activities for new and existing clients, helping ensure solutions are delivered on time and aligned to client requirements. You will work closely with clients and cross\-functional internal teams to coordinate project execution, maintain implementation standards, and support scalable, well\-documented delivery processes that contribute to successful client outcomes.

**What you'll do:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and internal teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Lead projects from initial planning through final implementation, coordinating activities with internal resources and external stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain project plans, task lists, timelines, and status updates to support delivery against client requirements.
* Configure implementation parameters and enter key setup information into proprietary systems and databases.
* Manage multiple implementation activities across internal teams to support timely completion and operational readiness.
* Maintain implementation documentation, procedures, and project audit records related to new products, features, and client\-specific requirements.
* Support issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and after\-hours implementation activities when needed.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

* 5\+ years of experience in project coordination, implementation, or project management supporting client delivery, installation, or solution rollout activities.
* 4\+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent projects, timelines, and stakeholder communications in a client\-facing environment.
* Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to create project documentation, status reporting, and implementation materials.
* Experience documenting implementation procedures, tracking deliverables, and supporting issue resolution across cross\-functional teams.
* High school diploma, General Educational Development (GED), associate degree, or higher, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience supporting electronic funds transfer (EFT), ATM, or financial services implementations.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience working with proprietary configuration tools, client setup workflows, or operational readiness processes.

**How you'll work:**

* This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

**Sponsorship:**


You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F\-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H\-1B, H\-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

**Benefits at Fiserv:**

* Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well\-being.
* Paid holidays and generous time away policies.
* No\-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs.
* Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards.
* Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network.
* Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities.
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one.
* Retirement planning including 401k match and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
* Tuition assistance and reimbursement program.
* Paid parental and military leave.


This role is not eligible to be performed in Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Nevada, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, Maine or Washington.

  

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.
